t: This is Zimbabwe House, a building in London designed by Charles Holden. Holden was an English architect best known for designing many London Underground stations during the 1920s and 1930s. He also designed the Underground's headquarters at 55 Broadway, Senate House for the University of London, and Bristol Central Library. Beyond the city, he created many war cemeteries in Belgium and northern France for the Imperial War Graves Commission. So the person behind this building is an architect with a very wide and varied body of work.
